title: Underworld penguin
description: The Underworld Penguin gives you a powerful shield that is resistant to lava, creeper blasts, and TNT.
body:
## 🔥 Underworld Penguin
Underworld Penguin introduces a formidable new challenge to the depths of the Nether. This mod adds a powerful, small, and aggressive creature that guards the fiery biomes, offering players the chance to obtain rare materials for the ultimate protective gear.

## 🐧 The Underworld Penguin (New Mob)
Don't let its size fool you! The Underworld Penguin is a dangerous inhabitant of the Nether that demands respect.

Location: Spawns in all Nether biomes.

Stats: It boasts a massive 150 Health points and a movement speed of 0.25.

Abilities: It attacks from a distance by shooting projectiles from its mouth, making it a deadly threat in the open lava fields.

Drops: Upon defeat, it drops 1 to 2 Underworld Horns, the core material for crafting legendary armor.

![This is a picture of a penguin from the Underworld. It appears small in size, yet its deeds are mighty; you need only look into its red eyes.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3183634debf15c7bb73a12cca7c1fe92faa173d9_0.webp)

## 🛡️ Underworld Armor Set 
By harvesting Underworld Horns, players can craft the Underworld Armor, a tier of equipment specifically designed for Nether exploration and combat.Superior Protection: This armor set provides exceptional resistance to Explosions (Creeper blasts, TNT) and Lava.Knockback Resistance: Each piece provides a +10 Knockback Resistance, ensuring you stay on your feet during intense battles.High Durability: With significantly higher Armor and Armor Toughness stats, this set is built to last.
## 📊 Armor Stats

| Piece | Armor | Armor Toughness | Knockback Resistance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Helmet** | +7 | +5 | +10 |
| **Chestplate** | +13 | +5 | +10 |
| **Leggings** | +10 | +5 | +10 |
| **Boots** | +7 | +5 | +10 |

## ⚒️ Crafting & Maintenance
To craft this powerful armor, you will need to combine Underworld Horns, Diamonds, and existing armor pieces (as shown in the crafting recipes).Recipe: Use 3 Underworld Horns + 3 Diamonds + 1 Base Armor Piece.Repair: Can be repaired using Underworld Horns at an anvil.

![An image displaying the "Lower Penguin Shield," showcasing its supernatural properties and how it is crafted on a crafting table.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8633ef99704dedc74ba4511f2f9ee782402c4b92_0.webp)

## 🛠️ Technical Specifications
Supported Versions: 1.14.4, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.8.

Platforms: Supports Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge.

Environment: Client-side.

## 📜 Credits & Permissions
Developer: FLASH_ZIO.

Modpacks: Feel free to include this mod in any modpack! Credit to the original page is appreciated.
